name: Karin Rebel '84
summary: A two-seat Karin off-road pickup that GTABase lists at $6,750 to register.
body: GTABase lists the Karin Rebel '84 as an Off-Road vehicle made by Karin, with 2 seats, AWD drive and 5 gears.
GTABase gives a registration cost of $6,750, a stolen sell value of $2,035, and no tracker.
GTABase lists its specialist type as Off-Road and its era as 1980s Restored.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 3.8, Acceleration 4.4, Asphalt handling 3.4, Off-road handling 6.5, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

facts.price: $6,750 (Story Mode price, which the guides read as the registration cost)
facts.customise: Specialist tag "Off-Road" (GTABase) matches the Off-Road specialty shop: Wasteland Off-Road or One-Eyed Willie's Auto Shop (Ultimate Edition)
facts.menu_text: Compact, rugged truck with a lean, functional design. Simple, but gets the job done.

name: Bravado Gauntlet Custom '69
summary: A two-seat Bravado muscle car that GTABase lists at $23,750 to register, with a Standard Tracker.
body: GTABase lists the Bravado Gauntlet Custom '69 as a Muscle vehicle made by Bravado, with 2 seats, RWD drive and 5 gears.
GTABase gives a registration cost of $23,750, a stolen sell value of $7,095, and a Standard Tracker.
GTABase lists its specialist type as Muscle and its era as 1960s Restored.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 5.4, Acceleration 5.0, Asphalt handling 3.6, Off-road handling 3.4, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

facts.price: $23,750 (Story Mode price, which the guides read as the registration cost)
facts.where: GTABase: '69 Bravado Gauntlet Custom kept in a barn in Ambrosia, partially restored with mods and a supercharger. Orange barn find Gauntlet.
facts.customise: Specialist tag "Muscle" (GTABase) matches the Muscle specialty shop: Capri Classic
facts.menu_text: Classic American muscle car with an unmistakable silhouette. Sometimes has modern security.

name: Sirius Sungrazer '61
summary: A two-seat Sirius coupe that GTABase lists at $15,500 to register, new to the series.
body: GTABase lists the Sirius Sungrazer '61 as a coupe made by Sirius, with two seats, and calls it a vehicle new to the series in GTA VI.
GTABase gives a registration cost of $15,500, a stolen sell value of $4,620, and a Standard Tracker.
GTABase lists its specialist type as Lowriders and its era as 1960s Restored.
GTA Wiki (edited November 19, 2026) describes the Sirius Sungrazer as a two-door sedan apparently based on the 1960-1961 Mercury Comet; GTABase files it as a coupe.
GTA Wiki's Sungrazer page gives no model year.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 3.6, Acceleration 3.6, Asphalt handling 3.3, Off-road handling 3.4, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

facts.price: $15,500 (Story Mode price, which the guides read as the registration cost)
facts.where: Spawn (GTABase map): Watson Bay -  #36 Sirius '61 Sungrazer Watson Bay
facts.customise: Specialist tag "Lowriders" (GTABase) matches the Lowriders specialty shop: Lowballers Customs
facts.menu_text: Chic, compact sedan with an unmistakably 1960s silhouette. Sometimes has modern security features.
